lines.en: I drift along, without feet

lines.zh: 白布一样的身体在风里起伏
lines.en: My sheet-like body swells in the wind
I rise, then settle again

lines.zh: 我穿过了石头，没有碰到
lines.en: I passed through the stone without touching
Light passes through me and falls on the ground
I swing as if hung on a hook

lines.zh: 我一边飘一边发出低响
lines.en: I drift with a low moan

lines.zh: 我的影子很淡，几乎看不见
lines.en: My shadow is faint, almost invisible

lines.zh: 我在墙里待了一会儿，又出来
lines.en: I stay inside the wall a while, then come out
Wherever the wind goes, I go
I do not go straight, I waver along

lines.zh: 我飘到你前面，又退回去
lines.en: I drift in front of you, then back
I hover, the white cloth stirring
I have no face, and I am watching
This corridor is dark, which suits me
I rise and fall slowly
My shadow is on the wall, faint

lines.zh: 我在等一个往下看的人
lines.en: I wait for someone who looks down

lines.zh: 我的边缘开始变得透明
lines.en: My edges are turning transparent
There were others here before

lines.zh: 我一直在这几个房间转
lines.en: I go around these few rooms

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，也不需要理由
lines.en: I need no breath, and no reason
You look at me, and I look at you
You have seen me like this before

lines.zh: 你吸气太急，白布跟着抖。
lines.en: Your breaths come fast; my white sheet trembles.
When I come close, you feel cold

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我知道你在动
lines.en: I have no eyes, and I know you moved
You step back, and I come forward

lines.zh: 白布的下面，什么都没有
lines.en: Under the sheet, there is nothing
I was the one who shut this door
Where you came from, I have forgotten

lines.zh: 你身上的热，我很不喜欢
lines.en: The warmth on you, I dislike it very much

lines.zh: 我在这道走廊等了你一会儿
lines.en: I have waited in this corridor a while
I do not smile, and I cannot
A piece of me scatters and returns
I tilt, the white sheet flutters
I have grown fainter
At that, a little of me was lost
I have no such thing as pain
My edges are thinning
I pull back into the wall

lines.zh: 你打不到我，可你确实打到了
lines.en: You cannot hit me, and yet you did
I am still right here
Did that one reach your ears

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我闻不出来
lines.en: I cannot smell what is in your hand
Do not hold it up, I do not eat
What I want is you

lines.zh: 我穿过去了，什么也没留下
lines.en: I passed through and left nothing

lines.zh: 你没有别的可以给了吗
lines.en: Have you nothing else to give

lines.zh: 这东西在你手里还热着
lines.en: That is still warm in your hand
Bringing it will not help you

lines.zh: 幽灵活着的时候，最爱追光。
lines.en: While a ghost lingers, it loves to chase the light.
You charged and passed through me
A layer of white frost rose on you
When I move, the wind goes cold
You stepped back, I have not moved
At that touch your chest went tight

lines.zh: 我的边缘黏在你袖子上
lines.en: My edge is stuck to your sleeve
You shivered once
Let me thin out and make way
Do not grab with your hand, it will not hold

lines.zh: 我没有可以给东西的身子
lines.en: I have no body to give anything with

lines.zh: 这地方死过人，我就是留下来的
lines.en: Someone died here, I am what stayed
You should look for something warm
I do not even have a face

lines.zh: 我们之间没有可以碰的地方
lines.en: There is nothing between us to touch

lines.zh: 你说话，我不回答，就是这样
lines.en: You speak, I do not answer, that is how it is
Each gust takes a little of me
There is only me and these walls
Go, do not linger here

lines.zh: 再待下去，你会变得和我一样
lines.en: Stay longer and you will become like me

lines.zh: 东西在我这里落不了地
lines.en: Things cannot land where I am
I look at it and it grows cold
I cover it with my body
A white layer formed on it

lines.zh: 我把它推了推，它滑开了
lines.en: I push at it, and it slides away
I cannot keep anything
You take it, I only want to watch
It fell within my shadow
Taking it will not help you
I noticed your footsteps

lines.zh: 这条走廊只有一个方向
lines.en: This corridor only has one direction
Your shadow is beneath me
I drift in front of you and block the way
I make a sound, very faint
You smell of the living
The door is no longer there

lines.zh: 我把身体拉长，堵住门口
lines.en: I stretch my body and fill the doorway

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏，我听得出
lines.en: I can hear the rhythm of your walking
I know this place better than you
Look down and you will see me

lines.zh: 我把这几间屋子的灯都压暗了
lines.en: I have dimmed the lamps in these rooms
Listen, the floor is creaking
I am where you did not expect
I drift behind you the whole way

lines.zh: 你转身，我已经在另一边
lines.en: You turn, and I am on the other side

lines.zh: 这道走廊我走了很多年
lines.en: I have walked this corridor for years
Walls are places I can enter

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在走廊里回响
lines.en: Your breath echoes in the corridor
I need not run, I only need to be
Your shadow is moving, that is me
Further on is a dead end

lines.zh: 我把这里的温度降下来了
lines.en: I have lowered the temperature here
Your breath is turning white
The door is behind me, I will not move

lines.zh: 我在你的视野边上，一直在
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight
Can you hear this sound
We have been circling a long while
I follow along the ceiling

lines.zh: 你数不清这屋里有几个我
lines.en: You cannot count how many of me are in this room
I have pushed the door shut

lines.zh: 你的脚步在这儿有回音
lines.en: Your steps echo here
I have never gone far
I pass through your chest

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，可你站不住
lines.en: It does not hurt, and you cannot stand
Your hands are shaking, that is the cold
I wrap part of you in me

lines.zh: 你被推了一下，没人碰你
lines.en: Nothing touched you, and yet you moved
Your sight is blurring
After that, your breathing went shallow
Your knees softened first
I pull away, and you breathe again
That sound is not the wind

lines.zh: 你抬手，手在空气里空着
lines.en: You raise a hand, and it closes on nothing
I stretch the lamp's shadow

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我散开了
lines.en: When you looked back, I scattered

lines.zh: 这个屋子里的空气都变重了
lines.en: The air in this room has grown heavy

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙也是冷的
lines.en: You back to the wall, and the wall is cold too

lines.zh: 这间屋子里本来什么都没有
lines.en: There was nothing in this room before

lines.zh: 我从墙上的一处暗影里出来
lines.en: I come out of a shadow on the wall
The light dimmed suddenly
A patch of white has joined the room
Cold begins to seep from the corner
I hang beneath the beam
The air here has turned white
My voice arrives first, then me

lines.zh: 地板上有一道很淡的影子
lines.en: A very faint shadow on the floor
The temperature here has dropped a few degrees
I am slowly taking shape
The wind stopped, and I am still moving

lines.zh: 屋子里的影子多了一个
lines.en: There is one more shadow in the room

lines.zh: 我慢慢从地板下面升起来
lines.en: I rise slowly through the floor
I was not in this wall a moment ago

lines.zh: 火光把我的形体照散了
lines.en: The firelight scattered my form

lines.zh: 我没有重量，可我还是往下坠
lines.en: I have no weight, and still I fall

lines.zh: 水和我混在一起，分不清了
lines.en: The water and I have mixed together

lines.zh: 炸开的风把我撕成几片
lines.en: The blast wind tore me into pieces

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带走了我的一部分
lines.en: The arrow went through and took part of me

lines.zh: 那股劲儿照出了我的形状
lines.en: That force showed my shape

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可我会慢慢变淡
lines.en: I do not eat, and I slowly fade

lines.zh: 雷光把整个屋子照白，我无处可躲
lines.en: The flash whitened the room, nowhere to hide
There is not even a shadow here
